name: menubar
useFor: Use in a tool where people work for a long time and expect desktop menus (an order console). Keep to a few menus with short names. Arrow keys move between menus and through their items.
constraints: A menubar as site navigation (use navigation menu)
source: Extension from opencommerce-agentcard-web src/app/globals.css (.btn-secondary, .nav-tray) and dropdown-menu.tsx
